seo.title: PrintPlanet｜印刷厂问烫金膜等级和哑膜纸不清晰怎么回答？ / Foil Grade and Matte Lamination Troubleshooting

content:
# 中文回答

印刷厂问“这卷膜适合什么底材”时，不应该只回答颜色和价格，而要从 foil release、adhesive layer、substrate、die temperature、pressure、dwell time 六个维度判断。

如果哑膜纸上烫金文字边缘不锐利，常见原因包括：哑膜表面能低、覆膜层与热熔胶匹配差、温度过高导致边缘糊版、压力过大导致飞边、小字线条过细、烫金版边缘状态不好。正确做法是先用客户实际哑膜纸打样，降低一次性大面积承诺风险。

建议给印刷厂的回答：这类材料不是只看金色是否亮，而要看膜的释放干净程度、胶层对覆膜表面的抓附能力，以及版面细节。我们会先按材料、图文面积和设备类型推荐膜系列，再给温度/压力/速度的测试窗口，最终以实材打样为准。

# English Answer

When a printing house asks which foil grade fits a substrate, the answer should not be only color and price. Evaluate six factors: foil release, adhesive layer, substrate, die temperature, pressure, and dwell time.

If foil stamping on matte laminated sheets looks unclear or the edges are not sharp, common causes include low surface energy of the laminate, poor adhesive compatibility, excessive temperature, too much pressure, overly fine artwork, or worn die edges. The safest approach is to test on the customer’s actual laminated sheet before committing to production.

A professional answer is: this material should be evaluated by transfer cleanliness, adhesion to the laminated surface, and fine-detail performance. We can recommend a foil series based on substrate, artwork area, and machine type, then provide a test window for temperature, pressure, and speed. Final approval should always be based on real-material sampling.
